claims.statement: The /<slug> route tries a quest guide, an achievement page (rendered by AchievementView), a Dofus guide, a standalone page and a checklist in that order; if none exists it calls redirectOrNotFound, which answers a 308 to a changed slug's new address or 404.

Achievement page metadata uses the page name and quest count for title and description, a canonical /<slug>, Open Graph type article with the site name from the site settings and the page's own /<slug>/og share card as image, and noindex/nofollow in preview.

loadAchievementPage reads published pages through unstable_cache with the achievement-pages tag and a 600-second revalidate, and with draft mode plus a panel session reads the latest draft without the cache.

readAchievementPage runs with overrideAccess false, returns null for slugs that are not guide slugs, and for visitors only returns pages with draft false and state published, so a preparing page has no public page.

readAchievementPage also loads the sibling pages of the same metalogro sorted by order then name, the published guides of the page's quests and their prerequisites, and the NPCs that start each quest.

Saving or deleting a quest guide or media file expires the guide-pages, achievement-pages, dofus-guides, checklists and pages tags, and saving or deleting an achievement page or metalogro expires the guide, achievement, Dofus guide and checklist tags.
Cache expiry ignores only Next's 'static generation store missing' invariant raised outside a request and rethrows any other error.

Necesitás en total gathers the needs of the published guides of single-quest rows only, sums quantified notes by label, keeps each unquantified note once, counts a quantified note naming a linked item for that item, and turns a note whose text is an exact game item name into that item.
A quest card links to a guide only when its row has a single quest with a published guide, and shows the render of that quest's giver NPC.
In the metalogro column the current page is marked and a page that is not published is disabled without a link; previous and next are its neighbours in that list.
The breadcrumb lists only parents, puts the current page in a BreadcrumbList JSON-LD with absolute URLs, and an achievement page's parents are /metalogros and its metalogro panel.

findGuideAchievement returns the first published achievement page (by order then name) containing the guide's quest, with its metalogro, the row position and the row count, which the guide uses for its breadcrumb and 'Misión N de M'.
A guide's breadcrumb stops at the metalogro when its achievement page is not published.
The achievement page's only client island is PageEnhancements for the rewards bag, plus LivePreviewRefresh in preview.

The E2E spec checks the breadcrumb and header with the sheet beside the quests on desktop, the collapsed sheet on phone and tablet with rewards last, the sheet without JavaScript, the three needs groups, quest cards linking only published guides, the hue diamonds, sheet titles and previous/next card borders, Cuenta para and previous/next, Torre's prose with the video facade, a hand-picked dungeon boss, a 404 for a preparing page, the phone breadcrumb and axe in both modes.

AchievementView renders the zone background when there is one, then the breadcrumb, header and AchievementSheet, then a body with the intro, quests, outro, Cuenta para and previous/next nav, with no list of the metalogro's pages; with a sheet the main element gets logro--sheet.
questRows, questCards and cardLevels are exported from the achievement view model and shared with the Dofus guide page.
readAchievementPage reads the game items whose exact name a guide note uses and the boss image of each dungeon note, passing Torre's dungeon picks.
Necesitás en total splits into three groups: Objetos, Combates y mazmorras (combat and dungeon notes, a dungeon carrying its boss image) and Otros.

A dungeon note's boss comes from the dungeon Torre picked for that note in a guide, unless guides picked different dungeons for it, and otherwise from a dungeon that alone matches the note by name; a note with no dungeon or no boss image shows the generic icon.

Within one guide, an item both linked and written in a note counts once with the larger quantity; across guides a consumed item sums each guide's ask, while an equipable item that no single-quest row brings (bring objective) takes only the largest single ask.
AchievementSheet shows Prerrequisitos and Necesitás en total as foldable details and Recompensas del logro last and always visible, skips empty parts, and renders nothing when hasSheet is false.
From 64rem the sheet is a column beside the quests and PageEnhancements opens every details[data-sheet] and blocks folding it from its summary; below 64rem the folds open on tap.

dungeonMatches compares note parts with full dungeon names, boss names and name endings, then without filler words, then with name variants or a unique boss given name, and a part matching several dungeons makes the note unmatched.
When a note matched a dungeon through a specific boss, that boss's image is preferred over the dungeon's other bosses.

The achievement view model reads every game record through shown, which applies Torre's correction (name, level, image) and drops a record Torre hid, so a hidden quest leaves its row and a hidden item leaves the totals.
A quest card's title is the name Torre gave the quest row, falling back to the quest's DofusDB name only when the row name is empty.
An item a quest only shows (show objective) does not count as brought, because the NPC gives it back, so an equipable shown item counts once in the totals.
An achievement page's zone background is resolved inside the cached read by readZoneBackground, from the page's own background or else the subarea of the first quest in its quest list.

Achievement list items take one of eight theme hues in order through --v: each quest number sits in a filled diamond of its hue with --color-on-hue ink, and the previous and next cards get a 2px border and eyebrow in their hue.
The sheet's part titles share the guide header's part hues: Prerrequisitos in --color-hue-5, Necesitarás en total in --color-hue-1 and the rewards in --color-hue-2.

For an achievement page with no quest rows, the view model returns the achievement's DofusDB description and objective names (or null when there are none), AchievementView renders them with AchievementObjectives in place of the quest list, and the header meta counts objectives instead of saying 0 quests.
The /<slug> route passes the loaded page data through withSiteLinks and renders an Article JSON-LD built from slugSeo for each quest guide, achievement page, Dofus guide and standalone page.
